> This is already feasible by just providing a different template (checkboxes). Thx @maxiloc

Nope, updating the template won't let you select multiple values. The widget has been designed to fit Amazon's UX; and therefore [only display the refined range if any](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/master/src/widgets/price-ranges/price-ranges.js#L163-L167) -> so you won't have the ability to click other ranges since they won't even be displayed.
